descFull: Solana-native verifiable compute and oracle protocol.  Programs accept a job, an input, constraints, and a callback. Randomness is the first job. An active node can fulfill a VRF request with an ECVRF proof after it locks the configured stake and sends a heartbeat. Fees still do not move.
